task: Review ALL documentation files in this repo and update them so every statement accurately describes the CURRENT codebase. The doc files in scope (and ONLY these may be modified): README.md, AGENTS.md, src/README.md, src/components/README.md, src/components/cv/README.md, src/layouts/README.md, src/pages/_README.md, scripts/README.md, src/content/README.md, docs/README.md, docs/depth-parallax-research.md, docs/docker.md, docs/performance.md. HARD CONSTRAINT: do NOT touch anything under src/content/ (no .mdx content files), and do NOT modify any code, config, or test files - docs only. For each doc file, read it fully, cross-check its claims against the actual repo (read the code/config it references), and fix what is stale or wrong: (a) version claims must match package.json (Astro 7.1.5, Tailwind 4.2.2, @astrojs/mdx 7.0.5); (b) component/layout/script inventories must match the actual files on disk - add missing ones, remove dead ones; (c) package.json script names and behaviors cited in docs must match; (d) the Pagefind search docs must reflect the CURRENT implementation: markup in src/components/Pagefind.astro references src/scripts/pagefind.ts via <script src>, and astro.config.mjs has a vite.build.assetsInlineLimit veto that keeps scripts emitted as chunks; (e) the islands are vanilla .astro components wired via astro:page-load - any doc describing React, .tsx files, or client: hydration directives is stale; (f) routes are config-driven [collection] parameters from src/config/collections.ts; (g) Tailwind config lives in src/styles/global.css (@plugin/@custom-variant/@theme) - tailwind.config.mjs is deleted; (h) remove or correct references to files/flags/scripts that no longer exist. Preserve each file's existing structure, tone, and formatting conventions - surgical edits, not rewrites. Keep mermaid diagrams syntactically valid. Do not invent features; if a doc describes something the code no longer does, fix the doc, not the code. NEW DELTAS since the last sweep that MUST be reflected: (i) reading times display as the remark plugin's human minutesRead string ("1 min read") on list cards, tag pages, and detail pages - formatReadingTime was deleted from src/scripts/utils.ts; any doc describing millisecond-precision reading times or formatReadingTime is stale; (j) NextPost.astro requests the favicon placeholder as format "png" because the SVT-AV1 4:2:0 path dropped the alpha plane (black square) - component docs describing the placeholder should mention the png choice; (k) @erfianugrah/astro-image-hq is now 0.1.5: it routes alpha-bearing images off SVT/NVENC to aom, clamps 4:2:0 AVIF output to even dimensions (odd-dim AVIFs fail to decode in Firefox), and hashes the package version into propertiesToHash so upgrades invalidate consumer image caches - AGENTS.md's Image Service section should mention these; (l) docs/plans/2026-08-04-streamline-stack.md section 3.2b says the upstream alpha fix is "still owed" - it landed in astro-image-hq 0.1.5, update that note; (m) astro-image-hq releases are OIDC trusted publishing via tag push (no NPM_TOKEN) - only if a doc discusses releasing. VERIFY: bun x prettier --check on every file you edited must pass, and .pi/check-doc-refs.sh must pass.

sensors.name: format
sensors.cmd: bun x prettier --check README.md AGENTS.md src/README.md src/components/README.md src/components/cv/README.md src/layouts/README.md src/pages/_README.md scripts/README.md src/content/README.md docs/README.md docs/depth-parallax-research.md docs/docker.md docs/performance.md
sensors.hint: Docs must stay prettier-clean. Run bun x prettier --write on the file(s) you edited.

sensors.name: doc-refs
sensors.hint: A doc references a repo path that does not exist. Fix the reference to point at the real path (check with ls/rg), or remove it if the referenced thing is gone.

sensors.name: no-stale-astro-version
sensors.cmd: ! rg -q 'Astro 6\b' AGENTS.md README.md src/README.md src/components/README.md src/layouts/README.md scripts/README.md src/content/README.md docs/README.md docs/depth-parallax-research.md docs/docker.md docs/performance.md
sensors.hint: The site runs Astro 7.1.5 (see package.json). Update stale Astro 6 version claims.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: bun ~/.pi/agent/skills/self-correcting-loop/judge.ts --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --spec 'FULL-REVIEW TASK: do not judge only the diff - read the CURRENT STATE of every doc file (README.md, AGENTS.md, src/README.md, src/components/README.md, src/components/cv/README.md, src/layouts/README.md, src/pages/_README.md, scripts/README.md, docs/README.md, docs/depth-parallax-research.md, docs/docker.md, docs/performance.md) and cross-check each file against the actual repo. FAIL and list every file:line where a doc statement is factually wrong or stale about the current codebase, including but not limited to: version numbers vs package.json (Astro 7.1.5); the Pagefind implementation (markup in src/components/Pagefind.astro, ALL search logic in src/scripts/pagefind.ts referenced via <script src>, assetsInlineLimit script-inlining veto in astro.config.mjs - any doc still describing the search logic as living inline in Pagefind.astro is STALE); component/layout/script inventories vs files on disk; package.json script names/behaviors cited in docs. Also FAIL if the diff modifies anything under src/content/ or any code/config/test file, or deletes substantive docs without accurate replacement. PASS only when every doc file is accurate about the current codebase.'
sensors.hint: The judge found doc claims that do not match the current codebase. Read the cited code and correct the doc statements - do not argue with the judge by weakening the spec.
